'''Station 22''' was a communication/jamming array used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Gwori]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Gwori]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] led a raid to secure the tower. Accompanied by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]], they dispatched the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. They managed to alert [[Jedi/Legends|Jedis]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], but the signal was cut off. [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Juhm]] contacted the station, and realized that the would-be-dead Jedi were alive, he prepared to activate the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]], but he didn't detonate it in time, allowing Tano, Rex and the Clone troopers to escape.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''
